title: RCF User Story
description: User Story document. One file per US. Contains its Acceptance Criteria inline as acceptanceCriteria[].

tags.description: Free-form tag list. Same shape as req.tags. Consumers may impose local conventions (for example, the rcf-lite blueprint-authoring checklist requires blueprint:<slug> on every US that a blueprint contributes). Optional at schema; absence is not an error.

scope.description: Scope at which this acceptance criterion is observable (library, runtime, deployed, unclassified). Optional at schema level; ruleset-enforcing consumers may require it. Governs which test scopes count as coverage for this AC.

determinism.description: Whether the AC's observable output is deterministic (same inputs, same outputs) or non-deterministic (LLM-generated text, ranked results, generated code, judgement calls). Optional at schema level; absence is treated as 'deterministic' by every consumer. Governs whether an EVAL is required by rcf audit eval coverage --strict and whether the merge gate emits EVAL-MISSING or EVAL-BELOW-THRESHOLD per-AC verdicts.

field.description: Optional dotted path into the owning TAC or ADR record (for example, 'interfaces.principal.fields' or 'decision.retryPolicy') that pinpoints the referenced surface. Optional; presence is not enforced.

acOwnerRef.description: Optional back-reference on an acceptance criterion naming the owning TAC or ADR the criterion observes rather than restating. All sub-fields are optional at schema level so the record composes additively; ruleset-enforcing consumers may require at least one of tacId or adrId when the criterion references an owning artefact.

acDisposition.description: Marks whether an acceptance criterion is the blueprint's to fix (mechanism-invariant, inherited unchanged by every applying project) or the applying agent's to set (project-parameterised, shape-given and value-open). Optional at schema level; consumer rulesets that gate blueprint contributions may require it on every AC of a shipped blueprint. Absence carries no default: a consumer that requires the marker treats an unmarked AC as a defect, and a consumer that does not require it ignores the absence.

url.description: Vendor documentation URL the third-party fact rests on. Consumers may fetch it at gate time so a dead link is a finding.

verifiedOn.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the vendor fact was verified against the cited URL. Consumers compare against their own tolerance window and refuse or warn when the citation is beyond it.

acVendorCitation.description: Vendor citation for an acceptance criterion whose truth rests on a third-party platform fact. Optional at schema level; consumer rulesets may require it on any AC that asserts a vendor fact (for example, a platform migration keyword or a rate-limit value).

authoredBy.description: Origin of the acceptance criterion. operator: hand-authored. baseline: injected by the shape-baseline sweep. operatorEdited: baseline entry the operator later edited in place; the baselineKey still traces so opt-outs remain linkable.

baselineKey.description: Catalogue key naming the baseline entry (for example webUi.sharedNav, auth.htmlLoginPage). Required in practice when authoredBy is baseline or operatorEdited.

sourceReqShape.description: Which parent-requirement shape triggered the injection.

acProvenance.description: Provenance for an acceptance criterion. Downstream consumers of acceptance criteria treat baseline and operator entries identically; this block is provenance only.
